responsibility: Coordinates specialized 'nice region error' diagnostics, wrapping region-resolution failures in `NiceRegionError`, extracting the relevant regions, and dispatching to more specific lifetime-conflict reporters for NLL and general inference errors.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the dispatcher for the specialized nice-region-error subsystem. It wraps `RegionResolutionError` data in `NiceRegionError`, extracts the conflicting regions, and selects among targeted lifetime-conflict reporters, whereas the parent `error_reporting/infer/mod.rs` handles broader inference diagnostics and `nice_region_error/util.rs` only provides helper routines used by these reporters.
